name: Medical Surgical Robot — 1 kHz Force-Feedback IRQ Storm
tagline: Unthrottled PCIe Endoscope IRQ 44 routed to CPU:00 causes 1 kHz haptic loop misses
description: 1 kHz surgical manipulator force-feedback loop (kinematics_ctrl, prio 58, 1.0 ms deadline) pinned to CPU:00 experiences repeated deadline misses when high-bandwidth endoscope DMA interrupts (IRQ 44, ~8.2 kHz) fire unthrottled on the exact same core instead of being routed to an isolated IST core.
